content:
{'translation': "Last week saw discounts on several current Apple products, including 25% off AirPods Pro 3 and the new AirPods Max 2 at $120 below the original price, but the deals aren't over yet. While those offers remain valid, Amazon has just dropped the price of the AirTag 2, launched by Apple in 2026, to an all-time low — a single unit can be picked up for around $20."}

{'translation': "We reported several times last week on record-low AirTag 2 prices during the anniversary sales. If you missed out, don't worry — the price has fallen again to the lowest level we've ever recorded."}

{'translation': "Amazon is currently selling a single AirTag 2 for $24, matching the best price we've seen since launch, while the 4-pack has dropped to $79.99 (including shipping)."}

{'translation': "Apple's official retail price for the 4-pack is $99, which is already better value than the standard $29 single unit. Now selling at nearly 80% of the original price, it's an all-time low, working out at around $20 per AirTag 2 on average."}

{'translation': "Logically, the previous $90 deal on the 4-pack might be expected to hold across major retailers' anniversary sales for a full week, but Amazon's all-time low may not stick around — the price could rise at any moment."}

{'translation': "We've previously covered the differences between the previous-generation AirTag and this year's AirTag 2 — full details can be found here, with the key points summarised below:"}

  • {'translation': 'Precision Finding with 1.5x greater range than the previous generation'}
  • {'translation': 'Speaker volume 50% louder than the original'}
  • {'translation': 'The AirTag 2 can play sounds from up to twice the distance'}
  • {'translation': 'Offers "an industry-first suite of unwanted tracking protections"'}

{'translation': 'Upcoming AirTag 2 features'}

{'translation': "The $20-per-unit AirTag 2 deal arrives ahead of the launch of iOS 27 and watchOS 27 next month. For Apple Watch users, there's a major upgrade: Precision Finding is being added to the Find My app, allowing you to locate AirTags using on-screen arrows and distance information directly from your Apple Watch."}

{'translation': 'watchOS 27 also consolidates the Find My experience into a single app. Previously, the Find My features on Apple Watch appeared as three separate icons — for people, items and devices — in the app list or pages.'}

{'translation': 'Additionally, iOS 27 brings a redesigned and refreshed interface to the Find My app, making it easier to track people and items.'}

{'translation': 'With that in mind, now is a great time to expand your AirTag 2 collection — especially at this price.'}

{'translation': 'More Apple deals this week:'}

  • {'translation': 'AirPods Max 2 — $429 (original price $549)'}
  • {'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3 — $190 (original price $249)'}
  • {'translation': 'AirPods 4 — $99 (original price $129)'}
